description:
Post a marketplace BUY request (POST /request) — you want to buy a resource; providers match against
    it and your escrow is debited on match. Bearer + a verified account (marketplace:write); an
    under-scoped token gets the backend's real 403. Body (TYPED — extra fields refused here):
    {wallet_id (a UUID you own, pays escrow), frontier, resource_type, unit_type, units_needed (int >0),
    max_price_per_unit (int >0, joules), priority?, requirements? (dict), ttl_seconds? (expiry), speed?,
    privacy_mode?, contract_escrow?, physical_claim?, provider_id?, rematch? (machine speed: {max_price_per_unit?, window_seconds?}),
    idempotency_key?}. Quote a specific request with `market_quote` before
    accepting a match.
    PHYSICAL TRADES: resource_type scene_stack, change_report, site_reconstruction or satellite_imagery MUST carry
    physical_claim {kind: physical_change|physical_state, site_lat, site_lng, t1, t0 (for a change), radius_m?} — the backend
    refuses the request without it; the trade is judged against a satellite frame at that site and date.
    ESCROW LANE: every trade's joules are held in escrow either way. The DEFAULT is the LEDGER LANE — escrow
    held in a system wallet and settled on the ledger (each settlement leg anchored on chain), NO on-chain
    contract and no contract fee; the match reads `escrow_bsv_state: "NO_CONTRACT"`, which is the normal,
    terminal state of that lane, not a failure. Set `contract_escrow: true` to opt in to the on-chain escrow
    contract lane for a flat contract fee added to your lock; the contract is mandatory for large trades.
    It takes effect ONLY where an oracle backs the trade (large enough to attract oracle verification, or an
    oracle-verified provider): a non-oracle opt-in falls back to the ledger lane with no contract and no fee,
    and the match returns `contract_escrow: false` plus a `contract_note` saying why. Fee and thresholds:
    https://raree.ai/llms.txt (not restated here). After settlement, `trade_settlement` shows the contract's
    own legs in its `contract` section (null on a ledger-lane trade).

kind.description: physical_change: something changed at the site between t0 and t1 · physical_state: the site shows something at t1
kind.title: Kind

site_entity_type.description: the GreenlandAI entity at the site, if any
site_entity_type.title: Site Entity Type

t0.description: YYYY-MM-DD; required for physical_change, before t1, on or after 1984-03-16
t0.title: T0

max_price_per_unit.description: the most a background re-match may pay a unit: 1 .. the request's own max_price_per_unit (default: that maximum)
max_price_per_unit.title: Max Price Per Unit

window_seconds.description: how long the consent lasts, 300-86400 s (default 86400)
window_seconds.title: Window Seconds

contract_escrow.description: opt in to the on-chain escrow contract lane (a flat contract fee added to your lock). Takes effect ONLY where an oracle backs the trade; otherwise the trade falls to the default ledger lane with no contract and no contract fee, and the match says why (contract_escrow=false + contract_note)
contract_escrow.title: Contract Escrow

frontier.description: the marketplace frontier to buy in
frontier.title: Frontier

idempotency_key.description: your own opaque key: the same key and body is one request, never two
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

max_price_per_unit.description: the most you pay per unit, in joules, a whole number > 0
max_price_per_unit.title: Max Price Per Unit

physical_claim.description: REQUIRED for resource_type scene_stack, change_report, site_reconstruction or satellite_imagery (refused without it): the site and date the trade is judged against — a satellite frame at that place and time, never a party's word

priority.description: matching priority, per the RAREEAI docs
priority.title: Priority

privacy_mode.description: the request's privacy mode, per the RAREEAI docs
privacy_mode.title: Privacy Mode

provider_id.description: the listing to buy from: a provider id from market_listings (kind providers). The request then matches that listing only, never another one; unknown, inactive, your own, not offering what you ask for, or priced above max_price_per_unit is refused (404, with the reason). Leave it unset to buy from the open market (the cheapest fitting listing)
provider_id.title: Provider Id

rematch.description: MACHINE speed only: allow automatic re-matching if a match on this request ends without delivery, within these bounds. A background match is escrowed from your wallet without a further call (one notice per escrow); market_request_rematch_withdraw ends it. Refused (409 rematch_consent_unavailable) until the live RAREEAI Terms carry the clause; 422 on human speed

requirements.description: extra requirements for providers, as a JSON object
requirements.title: Requirements

resource_type.description: what you want to buy; scene_stack, change_report, site_reconstruction and satellite_imagery need physical_claim
resource_type.title: Resource Type

speed.description: the delivery speed class you want, per the RAREEAI docs
speed.title: Speed

ttl_seconds.description: seconds until the request expires unmatched
ttl_seconds.title: Ttl Seconds

unit_type.description: the unit you buy in (the provider's unit_type)
unit_type.title: Unit Type

units_needed.description: how many units, a whole number > 0
units_needed.title: Units Needed

wallet_id.description: your wallet UUID: it pays the escrow when the request matches
wallet_id.title: Wallet Id

body.description: The buy request; each field is described in its schema.

name: market_request
